title: Sphirus World - first representative slice (house / shore / uphill trail)
brief: Existing Unreal Engine 5.9 project (sphirus_UE59). Use the references to improve world, character, camera and atmosphere of the first slice in place; no browser game, no Three.js prototype. Enclosed Woodland Refuge; natural human motion; close right-shoulder camera.

references.notes: Authority: hair mass (copper messy bob), relaxed standing posture, shoulder-arm relation, everyday clothing, fabric/leather/skin material approach. NOT authority: the face. The approved MetaHuman face (live asset SKM_MHC_Sph8_FaceMesh on BP_HybridA_Player) and the user edits stay; this sheet is not a new identity approval.
